```{=html}
<script>
  // Hide the download button until the PDF has been uploaded to cv/Halireena_Rushdiha_CV.pdf
  fetch("cv/Halireena_Rushdiha_CV.pdf", { method: "HEAD" })
    .then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(); })
    .catch(() => {
      const b = document.getElementById("cv-download");
      if (b) { b.style.display = "none"; }
      const n = document.getElementById("cv-note");
      if (n) { n.textContent = "The PDF is being updated. Please request the latest version using the form."; }
    });
</script>
```
